text:
Based on the discussions you had, design one improvement you could make to your prototype.

It could be an improvement to the hardware or to the Dataflow program.

If you design an improvement to the hardware, write down whether it's...

  • Feasible right now: you know what you need and all the materials are available
  • Maybe feasible later: you think you know what you need, and it's something you or your teacher could probably get
  • Probably not feasible during this class: it's an improvement that would help your user requires something that there's probably no way you could get, or it would take a suuuuper long time to make

Even if it's not feasible

If you design an improvement to the hardware, write down whether it's...

  • Feasible right now: You know what you need to make it work, and you have all the materials you need, and you can do it pretty fast.
  • Maybe feasible now or later: You think you know what you need. You might not have all the materials you need, but they're pretty easy for you or your teacher to get, and you could probably build it in a reasonable amount of time.
  • Probably or definitely not feasible during this unit: You need some materials that are quite hard to get, or it's really time consuming or complicated to build.

tiles.title: Sketch your improvement (you can replace this with a text tile if you want to describe it instead!)

text: How feasible is it? Why do you think so?

If you design an improvement to the software, write down whether it's...

  • Feasible right now: You know exactly what blocks you need to make it work. You could make it work right now!
  • Feasible with a bit of time or help: You think all the blocks exist in Dataflow, and you think you could probably make it work, but you might need some extra time or a bit of help.
  • Feasible with a lot of help: You think the blocks exist in Dataflow, but you really don't know what they are, or how to make it work. You think it's possible, but you'd need a lot of help.
  • Probably or definitely not feasible during this unit: You think some blocks you included don't exist in Dataflow or some connections you made don't work in Dataflow. It might be possible in some other coding language, but it's impossible in Dataflow!
